newsitem.title: USA: CIBCR leading U.S. inflation index 104.8 in Dec.
newsitem.headline: CIBCR leading U.S. inflation index 104.8 in Dec.

text.p: The Center for International Business Cycle Research (CIBCR) leading inflation index (LII) rose to 104.8 in December from a revised 103.5 in November, CIBCR said.
The six-month smoothed annualized growth rate of the LII increased to 1.9 percent from -0.6 percent, it said.
CIBCR said all the available components of the LII have increased in December.
The CIBCR is affiliated with Columbia University.
